rubric_items.reason: Job, service, actions, filter and detail page are tested, but S-7 (patient and doctor pages) and S-5 AC4 (dashboard tiles) have no test and no statement, and the server.ts start/stop wiring (CO-6) is untested.
Assertions check observable status, history, actor, HTTP codes and timer calls. The S-1 'one minute after 24h' claim does not match the test, which checks 61 minutes after for the open appointment.
Error paths covered: past reschedule 400, cancel without reason 400, closed 409, unknown status 400, job failure logging. The exact 24h boundary (at least 24h) is not tested.
Vitest/Supertest, fixed clock, skipIf without a DB and jsdom web tests match the strategy. Some names start with HMS-34 and carry no requirement ID ('HMS-34 regression').
No invented numbers. Passed tests are left to checks.json, and coverage is reported as not measured, which matches the verifier's coverage skip.
